name: Amounts And Value Date 8
definition: Specifies the value date and the amounts traded in a foreign exchange transaction.

TradingSideBuyAmount.name: Trading Side Buy Amount
TradingSideBuyAmount.definition: Currency and amount bought in a foreign exchange trade.

TradingSideSellAmount.name: Trading Side Sell Amount
TradingSideSellAmount.definition: Currency and amount sold in a foreign exchange trade.

SettlementDate.name: Settlement Date
SettlementDate.definition: Date on which the trade is settled, for example, the amounts are due.
